facts.fact: The Instance Nationale des Télécommunications (INT) opened a second public consultation on the rules for sharing fibre-optic access infrastructure from 6 March to 2 April 2026, open to any contributor to answer by email or post.
facts.system: Consultation publique sur la mutualisation des infrastructures d'accès en fibre optique - Phase 2

facts.fact: INT ran a first public consultation on the conditions for sharing fibre-optic access infrastructure from 26 September to 26 November 2025, as stated in the phase 2 announcement.
facts.system: Consultation publique sur la mutualisation des infrastructures d'accès en fibre optique - Phase 1
